Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <3s2f1d$b...@cgl.ucsf.edu>,

Eric Pettersen <pe...@homer.ucsf.edu> wrote:
>Okay, I have two questions which (this time) are hopefully not
>self-answering:
>
>1) Does Far Mastery have any effect on Charnas whatsoever?

Sure, but you usually wouldn't want Charnas on your side.

>2) Is the bleed modifer conferred by Spying Mission used before or after
>attempts to block?

Spying MIssion is not a bleed Modifier. It is a change-of-effect card
usable only on a successful bleed. You may play it (I suppose)
before the block attempts, but it will be useless if the bleed
does not resolve for a bleed of at least on pool. (Telepathic Counter
could also negate the effects of Spying Mission).
